audit.comparison_sources: Same dev names; compact TSV for counts/eligibility, saved fits for exact variant F and patch counts.

variant_equivalence.patch_decision_definition: Ordered (height_above_ground_m, side, area_m2, bool(dropped)); diagnostic fractions and redundant drop reasons do not alter the kept/dropped decision.
variant_equivalence.comparison: Sorted-key JSON of penetration_m and accepted, exact, no tolerance.

visual_review.method: All complete PNGs viewed in 15 uncropped four-up pages; both 3D and side panels reviewed.
